# TUBERCULOSIS

Please collect 3 AFB samples, at least one early AM sample. Management should be

done in conjunction with infectious disease Patients with suspected or proven

pulmonary tuberculosis must be in airborne isolation.

# _______________________________________________________________________________

Centers for Disease Control (CDC). Tuberculosis
